obligations.condition: A fresh pending credential completes phone MFA before aging; claims and derived lookup confirm the returned identity.

An independent pending credential remains untouched until at least 600 seconds after its acquisition response. Request a fresh SMS session and retain the start response plus measured pending-age interval. Acceptance and classified refusal are observations; neither establishes expiry causality.

If the 600-second start returned a session, finalize that fresh session and record token presence, claims and derived lookup checks. Otherwise skip. Keep start acceptance separate from full MFA completion; measure pending and session ages independently.

A fresh pending completes MFA after aging. It confirms the control account flow works at the end; it does not prove why a different account pending was refused.

limitations: A fully verified completion is a survival observation for the recorded configuration, method and single run, not a guarantee for every account.

A later invalid-pending refusal may supply a stage-specific boundary candidate using its measured age interval, never an established lifetime upper bound. Account equivalence, unchanged input/enrollment and monotonicity remain assumptions.
Missing pending and missing enrollment errors are possible input/account-state anomalies. Refusal followed by later success is nonmonotonic evidence, not a single-boundary proof.
The independently-valid-code versus expired-pending residual remains unobserved. No exact TTL, error precedence, tenant, blocking-function, SDK or Rules claim is made.
Administrative token expiry is checked through tokeninfo; acquisition age is only an additional refresh trigger. Privileged operations and refresh commands are phase-budgeted.
This source mapping does not grant execution permission or approve results. The project owner authorized the recorded production run separately; the receipt and comparison remain candidate.
